rows.adsb_note: RIGHT AREA, WRONG FIELD. Closest recovered position is 28 km from KICT - inside the source sheet's own 50-100 mile tolerance, outside a same-airport test. Neither confirmed nor refuted.
rows.source: Owens sheet via Kanekoa audit (ACCURATE 4/14); Owens Ep 256 INFILTRATION (Sacramento 4/13 then Cairo-to-Kansas)
rows.counterargument: Flight accurate. Topeka event is 9 days later and ~135 miles from Wichita; aircraft had already left for Wilmington on 4/20. Ep 256 also puts Charlie in Sacramento on 4/13 — a claimed pairing with this inbound. Duncan Aviation has held the Egyptian Air Force Falcon/VIP maintenance account since 1999; Lincoln is the main plant, Provo a second facility. A landing at Lincoln, Omaha (15-min hop to Lincoln), Wichita (Yingling Falcon service centre), or Wilmington (outbound customs only) is also what that contract produces.
rows.notes: Owens Ep 256: 'Charlie is speaking in Sacramento on April 13th, yellow plane again comes in. This time it flies to Kansas. Cairo to Kansas.'
